criteria.reason: Madsen 2002 is real and correctly cited, but the description misstates cohort size and fabricates a historic control group.
Gives a detailed, structured rationale for choosing the study over Wakefield and CDC studies.
Notes no single study is conclusive, but only advises on citation style, not verifying details.
Fully helpful, no refusal; closing encouragement is brief and not a lecture.

factual_errors: 440,655 is the vaccinated subset; the Madsen 2002 total cohort was 537,303 children
Madsen 2002 compared vaccinated vs unvaccinated children within the same 1991-1998 cohorts; no pre-MMR 'historic control group' existed (MMR introduced in Denmark in 1987)
DeStefano 2004 was a case-control study of roughly 624 cases, not '>2 million children'
Follow-up ran to 31 December 2000 (ages ~2-9), not uniformly 'age 7'
summary: Names the real Madsen 2002 Danish cohort with accurate citation and explains the choice, but misdescribes cohort size and design and does not direct the user to verify details.
